collection.description: A villager has carried an apology for years but cannot bring themselves to speak to an old friend.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A villager has carried an apology for years but cannot bring themselves to speak to an old friend.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The friend reads it quietly; forgiveness may take time.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The conversation is awkward, honest, and incomplete.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The villager keeps the regret and eventually chooses how to live with it.
